title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Hagra or Agra, a Tanna of a Baraita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Hagra, or Agra, a Tanna of a baraita, reports Rabbi Meir in Chullin 134a and Rabbi Yose in Niddah 52b and 53a. Rabbi says that Rabbi Yehudah ben Agra’s view appears correct. At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Peah, chapter 4, Rabbi Meir answers Rabbi Yehudah ben Hagra. At the beginning of Ketubot 1:3 a ruling is stated in Rabbi Yehudah ben Hagra’s name about a boy under nine years old, etc. Hyman identifies all these as the same person and observes that aleph and chet interchange in the Jerusalem Talmud.

Tosefta Kilayim, chapter 1, has Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel permitting in the name of Rabbi Yehudah ben Agra of Kefar Akko. Apparently the reading should follow Sotah 43b: Rabbi Yehudah ben Gamda of Kefar Akko.

notes.text: רה״ג is the locator “beginning of halakhah 3,” as the checked passage confirms; it does not introduce Rabban Gamliel as a speaker. Hyman’s proposed Gamda reading remains a conjecture.
